note: The train/val cut is a plain positional slice through file-concatenated, NOT shuffled windows (combined_mae_multidata_loader.py _build_ocdetect). At this build, the boundary file happens to end exactly at a file boundary this time (no straddle). This is incidental to the current file selection/ordering, NOT a property of the split logic itself -- a different `sample_fraction`/`max_files`/file count would very likely reintroduce the straddle. The split logic is unsafe in general even when this particular build got lucky.
